LanguageData.MB_Z1_Desc: A fuller BB-style female figure with visible arms. Wears FemaleBB (or Female) clothes.
LanguageData.MB_Z2_Desc: A softer BB-style female figure with visible arms. Wears Female clothes.
LanguageData.MB_M1_Desc: A muscular male figure with visible arms. Wears Hulk clothes.
LanguageData.MB_M2_Desc: A slim male figure with visible arms. Wears Male clothes.
LanguageData.MB_Bodies: New body types: F1 BB, F2 soft BB, M1 muscular, M2 slim (selectable in the character editor).
LanguageData.MB_Chance: Share of newly generated people that get a new body: {0} %
